rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is true to a limited degree.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 di1 gwai3 wo3

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize that the degree is small, similar to “a little.”

example.english: It’s somewhat cold today, so put on another layer.
example.traditional: 今日有少少凍，著多件衫啦。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau5 siu2 siu2 dung3 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 laa1
